steps.npc: A unique farming patch. This cave is the only place we've succesfully been able to grow a Hespori.
A rare carnivorous plant originally from Morytania. When grown, the plant becomes conscious and highly aggressive. They are truly fascinating.
Of course. Just plant some Hespori seeds in the cave below and it will grow like any other plant. A Hespori is pretty tough so you don't need to worry about it getting diseased.
Do be careful though. A fully grown Hespori can be quite troublesome to deal with.
